newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Budapest BSE approves Styl's suspension request.
newsitem.headline: Budapest BSE approves Styl's suspension request.

text.p: The Budapest Stock Exchange's council approved the request of garment plant Styl Ruhagyar to suspend trading in its shares for three days while it implements a bonus share issue, BSE CEO Jozsef Rotyis said.
"The suspension is necessary...and because of the settlement system an adequate temporary period is necessary without bourse trade," Rotyis said.
"The suspension has nothing to do with the company's operation, it is of a technical nature."

Styl plans to raise its 1.18 billion forint issued share capital to 1.77 billion forints via a rights issue, the company said in June. In the issue the company will give shareholders free of charge one new share for every two they hold by capitalising 590 million forints of its reserves.
Rotyis said the bourse asked Styl to inform the bourse about its planned transaction date five trading days before and the bourse council will announce it at least three days before.
